I've designed the 100 experiments as 50 matched pairs. In each pair the edit is identical and the two parent cells differ only on the conditioning edge, or on the op being replaced. That way any difference in the edit's effect points to that one interaction.

| Area | What the pairs test |
|---|---|
| **Dead paths** | Edits on edges 0, 1, 2 or 5 when node 1 or node 2 is disconnected or has no output, versus connected. |
| **Direct path (edge 3)** | Removing or adding the 0→3 edge when the other paths into node 3 (edges 4 and 5) are cut, versus convolutional. |
| **Op being replaced** | The same edit replacing none, skip, pool, 1×1 conv or 3×3 conv. |
| **Op mix** | Adding pool or skip next to other pools or skips, versus next to convs, which tests over-smoothing or a lack of capacity. |
| **Serial context** | Whether the conv/skip choice on edge 2 or edge 4 depends on what edge 0 carries. |
